spec.source: export default async function () { const snapshot = (await host.call('context.snapshot', {})).result; const key = 'title'; if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(snapshot.metadata, key)) return false; const first = Array.from(snapshot.items).find(item => item.channel === 'user_text'); if (!first) return false; const helper = (await host.call('helper.run', {selection:{kind:'restricted',profile:'title'},task:JSON.stringify(first),maxTurns:1,deadlineMs:10000,responseBytes:4096,completionBytes:8192})).result; const title = helper.response.trim(); if (!title || title.length > 60) throw new Error('invalid title'); return (await host.call('context.transact', {source:snapshot.source,expectedRevision:snapshot.revision,predicates:[{key,value:{state:'absent'}}],updates:[{key,value:{state:'present',value:title}}]})).result.committed; }
